title: M5 Plan-set and Plan-pair governance decisions
goal: Record accepted D28-D30 resource, ownership and authoring-authority decisions without changing the Plan runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-045 records versioned initial Plan-set limits, exclusive changed-path ownership and concurrent-authoring reconciliation.
V4-AD-046 records executable JSON and matching review Markdown generated from one structured authoring model.
Only finalized operator-confirmed output reconciled to the exact diff may authorize implementation.
V4-TODO-013 remains open for enforcement and V4-TODO-024 tracks scaffold, analysis, finalization and Workbench implementation.
No product code, contract, Plan runtime, test, workflow, package, consumer repository or remote state changes occur.
risks: Unbounded Plan sets could exhaust validation resources or overwhelm review.
Concurrent authors could claim the same path or finalize against different bases.
Generated Markdown or model output could be mistaken for executable authority.
decisions: D28 accepts explicit member, byte, depth, path, command, entry and time ceilings.
D29 accepts concurrent authorship with exclusive finalized path ownership and exact rebase reconciliation.
D30 accepts one structured authoring model, executable JSON, matching review Markdown and deterministic Guard-owned validation.
